title: OpenAI releases GPT-6 Astra
summary: OpenAI announced the release of GPT-6 Astra, described as the first model of the AGI era. It features autonomous vulnerability discovery and a new reasoning approach where thoughts are partially hidden. Access is being rolled out to Daybreak program participants, then to Pro, Plus, Business, and Enterprise subscribers and API users at a price of $10/$50 per million tokens.
